description: This file provides functions to fetch the project name from a backend API, using axios and utility functions for base URL and client retrieval. It includes a main method `fetchProjectNameDirect` that retrieves the project name via API call, and a deprecated alias `fetchProjectNameByProjectId`. The code manages fallback mechanisms and error handling for the API requests.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the project name for a given project ID via dedicated API endpoint, with fallback to axios request if API client is not available.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId(projectId)
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for compatibility.
